newsitem.title: USA: Strike at Exide lead smelter ends, deal ratified.
newsitem.headline: Strike at Exide lead smelter ends, deal ratified.

text.p: The strike at Exide Corp's Reading secondary lead smelter in Pennsylvania has ended and the workers have returned to work, a company official said.
"It has been settled. They are back to work as of today," a company official said Monday.
The employees, who walked out last week after their labor contract expired, voted Sunday to accept a new pay deal, the official added. No further details were available.

The company said last week that management from other plants were called in to run the smelter. The official on Monday was unable to say if the 90,000 short tons per year plant was now opearating at full capacity.
Exide's battery making and distribution operations at Reading were unaffected by the dispute, the company has said.
